subset_size_thresholds.n_ge_30: MAE+CI treatment above, PLUS regime-ranking statistics (median_abs_mae_gap, spearman_rho, kendall_tau, top_model_selection_regret)
subset_size_thresholds.below_20: descriptive only (n, mean, median, spread) -- no bootstrap CI, no regime-ranking statistic is computed for a subset this small

branch_1.condition: crystalline-unseen subset (n>=20, so a regime comparison exists) shows family-aware internal-CV median |MAE gap| < random-CV's median |MAE gap| against that subset's external MAE

branch_2.condition: the same smaller-gap pattern holds only for the glass/glass-ceramic subset, not for crystalline-unseen
branch_2.framing: unseen material class (amorphous), not chemistry novelty

branch_3.condition: crystalline-unseen n is below the n>=20 threshold

conditional_framing_rule.evaluation_order: branch_3 is checked FIRST (a sample-size gate on what can be computed at all), then branch_1, then branch_2 -- if branch_3 fires for crystalline-unseen, branches 1/2 can still independently apply to the glass subset using its own (independently thresholded) regime comparison, but the crystalline subset itself is never given a regime-ranking verdict regardless of what its raw numbers would have shown.
